notes: Stacking controller: closed-loop Cartesian state machine with damped-least-squares IK on the private kinematic model (warm-started, null-space pull on shoulder roll to avoid torso self-collision), plus a slow integral "sag" correction of joint targets from the measured grasp-site error (handles weak motors). Grasp is top-down (palm down): hand yaw chosen to align a cube face, from candidates (cube yaw mod 90 ±90°) verified reachable and self-collision-free with IK + mj_forward contact check at the approach and grasp points. Site is placed 1.5 cm toward the fingers from the cube centre (thumb clearance against sensing bias) and 4 mm above centre; closure ramps 0→0.5 (fingers curl, push cube against thumb) then 0.5→1 (thumb squeezes), gentle lift, measure cube offset in site frame, carry to 4 cm above the destination cube, lower to a 6 mm gap, instant release, retreat, check; retries re-pick on failure (grasp failure or mis-stack). Tested: nominal 30/30, heavy_slippery 12/12, weak_motors 10/10, noisy_sensing ~75-80% (remaining failures: cube occasionally pops out or lands off-centre when position bias is large; retry loop sometimes runs out of time). Weaknesses: thumb tip touches the table slightly at grasp height; no explicit avoidance of neighbouring cubes with the open fingers; yaw changes while carrying could loosen slippery grasps.
